about.pageSubtitle: Discover the concept behind irreallab and meet the creator shaping these surreal visual experiments.
about.conceptText: irreallab is a creative laboratory dedicated to exploring the boundaries between art, technology, and imagination. Each visual experiment is a dive into surreal abstraction, where forms, colors, and motion combine to create ephemeral and captivating worlds.
about.philosophyText: irreallab is rooted in the belief that technology is not a creative limitation, but rather a powerful tool for exploring new artistic territories. Each creation is a conversation between human intention and the possibilities offered by artificial intelligence and digital tools.
about.creatorBio: Radu Nechita is the creator and visionary behind irreallab. With a passion for digital art and emerging technologies, he uses artificial intelligence, image generation tools, and creative technologies to create unique and immersive visual experiences.
about.designCredit: This website was designed and built by Hélène Nechita, a professional website creator and digital designer. With a focus on clean design, responsive layouts, and user experience, Hélène brings irreallab's creative vision to life online.
about.conceptGridItem1Text: Leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to create unprecedented visual experiences.
about.conceptGridItem2Text: Pushing boundaries of digital art through abstract and dreamlike visuals.
about.conceptGridItem3Text: Professional-grade cinematography adapted for short-form content.
about.conceptGridItem4Text: Creating moments that resonate and leave lasting impressions.

contact.formDescription: Share a few details and I'll come back to you with ideas and next steps. No commitment — just a conversation.
contact.note: Your message goes straight to irreallab@proton.me — I reply personally.

contact.kicker: Commercial video · Brand films · Social ads
contact.heroCopy: I turn your product, story or campaign into cinematic short-form video — AI-driven visuals with a surreal, scroll-stopping signature. Built for social, ads and launches.
contact.s1Text: Cinematic 15–60 second films that give your product a world of its own.
contact.s2Text: Vertical, loop-friendly edits designed to stop the scroll and carry your message.
contact.s3Text: Surreal hooks for drops, events, music releases and announcements.
contact.s4Text: Moodboards, storyboards and a visual identity for motion — before a single frame is made.
contact.p1Text: Tell me about your brand, your goal and your audience.
contact.p2Text: I propose a visual direction and a storyboard for your approval.
contact.p3Text: AI-driven generation, editing and sound design, with your feedback along the way.
contact.p4Text: Final cuts in every format you need, ready to publish.
